design_detail: Progressive annual net wealth tax and removal of share valuation discount
quote_original: SV vil redusere forskjellene i makt og rikdom i samfunnet vårt, og mener de aller rikeste bør bidra mer til fellesskapet. Derfor ønsker vi en mer progressiv formuesskatt, å fjerne rabatten for aksjer i formuesskatten
quote_en: SV wants to reduce differences in power and wealth in our society, and believes the richest should contribute more to the community. Therefore we want a more progressive wealth tax, removing the discount for shares in the wealth tax
source_title: Formuesskatt - SV
grading_note: Party policy page detailing progressive annual net wealth tax design.

design_detail: Defending annual net wealth tax and rate increases against repeal
quote_original: Formuesskatten gjør at de rikeste bidrar til fellesskapet, og er med på å redusere forskjeller. Vi vil dette med formuesskatten: Omfordele mer ved å beholde endringene våre i formuesskatten for et likere og mer rettferdig Norge.
quote_en: The wealth tax ensures that the richest contribute to the community, and helps reduce inequality. We want this with the wealth tax: Redistribute more by keeping our changes in the wealth tax for a more equal and fair Norway.
source_title: Formuesskatt | Arbeiderpartiet
grading_note: Party platform defending existing wealth tax and rate increases.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax with high standard deductions, defending against abolition
quote_original: Senterpartiet mener at skatt på inntekt, formue og næringsoverskudd er viktige finansieringskilder for fellesskapet, og at skattebyrden skal fordeles rettferdig. Dette innebærer skatt etter evne, både for inntekt og formue. Senterpartiet støtter en progressiv inntekts- og formuesskatt med høye bunnfradrag.
quote_en: The Centre Party believes that tax on income, wealth and business surplus are important sources of financing for the community, and that the tax burden must be distributed fairly. This entails tax according to ability, both for income and wealth. The Centre Party supports a progressive income and wealth tax with high standard deductions.
source_title: Formuesskatt - Senterpartiet
grading_note: Official party programme entry defending wealth tax against abolition.

design_detail: Increased wealth tax rate on the largest fortunes with higher basic deduction
quote_original: Øke bunnfradraget i formuesskatten kraftig og øke skattesatsen for de aller største formuene.
quote_en: Substantially increase the basic deduction in the wealth tax and increase the tax rate for the very largest fortunes.
source_title: Skatt og avgifter | Miljøpartiet De Grønne
grading_note: Party tax platform calling for higher wealth tax rate on largest fortunes.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax against abolition and supporting progressive wealth taxation
quote_original: Formuesskatten er derfor vårt viktigste verktøy for å redusere økende forskjeller gjennom skattesystemet.
quote_en: The wealth tax is therefore our most important tool to reduce growing inequality through the tax system.
source_title: Spørsmål og svar om formuesskatt
grading_note: Official LO publication defending wealth tax as principal anti-inequality tax tool.

design_detail: Increased wealth tax rates to reduce wealth inequality
quote_original: Formuesskatten må økes gjennom økte skattesatser, og hvor det kan vurderes å øke bunnfradrag, slik at vanlige lønnsmottakere ikke blir berørt av skatten.
quote_en: The wealth tax must be increased through higher tax rates, and where increasing the basic deduction can be considered, so that ordinary wage earners are not affected by the tax.
source_title: Fagforbundet vil utjevne forskjellene og øke formueskatten
grading_note: Union submission calling for increased wealth tax rates.

design_detail: Increased wealth tax on the largest fortunes
quote_original: Vi ønsker en omfordelende skattepolitikk, der vi sikrer at de som har mest, også betaler mer. Vi må se på totalen når vi skal diskutere skattepolitikken for fremtiden, sier SV-lederen.
quote_en: We want a redistributive tax policy, where we ensure that those who have the most also pay more. We have to look at the total picture when discussing tax policy for the future, says the SV leader.
source_title: Skatteforliket: Nå er SV-lederen bekymret
grading_note: SV leader presenting party tax proposals including increased tax on largest fortunes.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax against proposed 20bn NOK cut
quote_original: Formuesskatt er den de aller rikeste i Norge, de som eier dagligvarekjeder, har store aksjeposter i bankene, som driver med finans- og eiendomsutvikling, betaler. Da blir det helt feil å kutte i denne skatten og la arbeidsfolk, pensjonister og uføre sitte igjen med regninga, mener hun.
quote_en: Wealth tax is what the very richest in Norway, those who own grocery chains, have large shareholdings in banks, who run finance and property development, pay. Then it is completely wrong to cut this tax and leave workers, pensioners and disabled people with the bill, she believes.
source_title: Milliarder i skattelette til de rikeste: – Sinnssyk prioritering
grading_note: Rødt leader defending the wealth tax against proposed 20bn cut.

design_detail: Defending municipal wealth tax against 15m NOK local loss from abolition
quote_original: Kragerø-ordfører Charlotte Therkelsen sier at kutt i formuesskatten vil ramme inntektene til kommunen.
quote_en: Kragerø mayor Charlotte Therkelsen says that cuts to the wealth tax will hit municipal revenues.
source_title: Milliarder i skattelette til de rikeste: – Sinnssyk prioritering
grading_note: Mayor calculating municipal revenue losses and defending municipal wealth tax.

design_detail: Multi-bracket wealth tax with higher rate over 20m NOK
quote_original: Formuesskatten kan utformes slik at eiere av mindre bedrifter får lettelser uten at eiere av store formuer betaler mindre skatt, skriver professor Jarle Møen.
quote_en: The wealth tax can be designed so that owners of smaller businesses receive relief without owners of large fortunes paying less tax, writes Professor Jarle Møen.
source_title: Småbedriftsvennlig formuesskatt
grading_note: NHH economics professor op-ed proposing progressive wealth tax design.

design_detail: Permanent annual wealth taxes starting at 2% for millionaires and up to 5% for billionaires
quote_original: Jeg har signert oppropet fordi et bedre skattesystem er et viktig tema for meg som bedriftsleder. Å øke skatten på formue, og redusere den på arbeid, vil gjøre økonomien mer effektiv og rettferdig.
quote_en: I signed the appeal because a better tax system is an important issue for me as a business leader. Increasing tax on wealth, and reducing it on work, will make the economy more efficient and fair.
source_title: Norsk gründer og 101 andre superrike krever å få betale mer skatt
grading_note: Wealthy entrepreneur signing millionaire open letter In Tax We Trust for permanent wealth taxes.

design_detail: Defending municipal wealth tax against local cuts and tax competition
quote_original: Hvis flere og flere kommuner senker skattene sine, vil de totale skattene som går til Kommune-Norge falle, og dette taper de fattigste kommunene mest på.
quote_en: If more and more municipalities lower their taxes, the total taxes going to Local Government Norway will fall, and the poorest municipalities will lose the most.
source_title: Ikke la Asker bli skatteparadis
grading_note: Civil society op-ed defending municipal wealth tax against local cuts.

design_detail: Defending 35bn NOK annual wealth tax against proposed 20bn cut
quote_original: Jo da, formuesskatt er ikke den eneste skatten vi har for å beskatte landets rikeste, men at den er sentral i å minske økonomisk ulikhet og motvirke maktkonsentrasjon er det ikke tvil om.
quote_en: Sure, the wealth tax is not the only tax we have to tax the country's richest, but there is no doubt that it is central to reducing economic inequality and countering concentration of power.
source_title: Pengemakt
grading_note: Newspaper editorial defending the wealth tax against proposed 20bn cut.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax and calling repeal poison in the Norwegian model
quote_original: der han omtala fjerning av formuesskatten som «gift i den norske modellen» - fordi mange av dei rikaste då ikkje ville betale skatt.
quote_en: where he described the abolition of the wealth tax as "poison in the Norwegian model" - because many of the richest would then not pay tax.
source_title: Utfordrar Vedum om skatt på landbrukseigedom
grading_note: Finance Minister defending the wealth tax against repeal.

design_detail: Defending annual wealth tax against abolition and warning against zero-taxpayers
quote_original: Høyre vil fjerne hele formuesskatten. Ikke mer, eller mindre formuesskatt, men fjerne alt. Høyre er besatt av formuesskatten, sa Jonas Gahr Støre. – Det vil gi 25 000 nye nullskattytere.
quote_en: Høyre wants to eliminate the entire wealth tax. Not more, or less wealth tax, but eliminate everything. Høyre is obsessed with the wealth tax, said Jonas Gahr Støre. – That will create 25,000 new zero-taxpayers.
source_title: Jonas Gahr Støre mener Høyre er besatt av formuesskatten
grading_note: Labour Party leader speech defending the wealth tax against abolition.

design_detail: Opposing wealth tax cuts and calling for stronger taxation of billionaires
quote_original: Dette er skreddersydde skattekutt for landets aller, aller rikeste. Vi får stadig flere milliardærer i Norge. De aller fleste av dem betaler knapt skatt nå.
quote_en: These are tailored tax cuts for the country's very, very richest. We get ever more billionaires in Norway. The vast majority of them barely pay taxes now.
source_title: Solbergs regjering har gitt ni milliarder kroner i skattelette
grading_note: SV chief finance spokesperson criticizing wealth tax cuts and calling for taxing billionaires.

design_detail: Third bracket in the wealth tax for fortunes over 100 million NOK
quote_original: Formuesulikheten i Norge er ekstremt høy. Dagens skattesystem fungerer sånn at det rikeste prosenten betaler en lavere prosentandel i skatt den det en sykepleier eller rørlegger gjør. Sånn kan vi ikke ha det
quote_en: Wealth inequality in Norway is extremely high. Today's tax system functions in such a way that the richest percentile pays a lower percentage in taxes than what a nurse or plumber does. We cannot have it like that
source_title: Rødt vil hente milliarder i økte skatter
grading_note: Rødt finance spokesperson presenting budget proposal with increased wealth tax over 100m NOK.

design_detail: Defending the wealth tax to ensure broad distribution of the tax burden
quote_original: ville Berg beholde dagens skatt fordi den «sikrer bred fordeling av skattebyrden og forhindrer at det blir flere nullskattytere.»
quote_en: Berg wanted to retain the current tax because it "secures a broad distribution of the tax burden and prevents more zero-taxpayers from emerging."
source_title: MDG gikk for kompromiss om skatt
grading_note: MDG MP defending wealth tax to prevent zero-taxpayers and distribute burden.

design_detail: Defending wealth tax as indispensable for ensuring the richest pay taxes
quote_original: Store deler av de rikeste i Norge ville ikke betalt skatt om det ikke var formueskatt, forteller Kalle Moene, professor i samfunnsøkonomi ved Universitet i Oslo.
quote_en: Large parts of the richest in Norway would not pay taxes if it were not for the wealth tax, says Kalle Moene, professor of economics at the University of Oslo.
source_title: Økonomiprofessor: De rikeste må betale mer skatt
grading_note: Economics professor defending wealth tax as necessary to prevent untaxed fortunes.

design_detail: Policy paper showing wealth tax reduces inequality and does not reduce jobs
quote_original: Formuesskatten er et effektivt virkemiddel for å redusere formuesulikhet.
quote_en: The wealth tax is an effective policy instrument for reducing wealth inequality.
source_title: Gjør formuesskatten det vanskeligere å være rik i Norge?
grading_note: Think tank briefing analyzing wealth inequality and defending progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: Defending wealth tax as sound policy against abolition
quote_original: Fjernar vi formuesskatten, vil nokon av samfunnets rikaste betale ingen eller berre litt skatt. Det er vanskeleg å forsvare i møte med alle andre truskyldige skattebetalarar her i landet.
quote_en: If we abolish the wealth tax, some of society's richest will pay none or only a little tax. That is difficult to defend in the eyes of all other trusting taxpayers in this country.
source_title: Formuesskatt er sunn fornuft
grading_note: Think tank op-ed defending the wealth tax against conservative abolition arguments.

design_detail: Trade union statement criticizing wealth tax cuts and defending progressive taxation
quote_original: Regjeringens kutt i formuesskatt hjelper ikke vanlige folk for å si det slik
quote_en: The government's cuts in the wealth tax do not help regular people to put it that way
source_title: Lønnsoppgjøret starter igjen: – Vi vil kjempe for dem som sitter nederst ved bordet
grading_note: Union leadership defending progressive taxation and opposing wealth tax cuts.

design_detail: Trade union leader statement criticizing wealth tax cuts and defending redistribution
quote_original: Regjeringens kutt i formuesskatt hjelper ikke vanlige folk for å si det slik
quote_en: The government's cuts in the wealth tax do not help regular people to put it that way
source_title: Lønnsoppgjøret starter igjen: – Vi vil kjempe for dem som sitter nederst ved bordet
grading_note: Fellesforbundet leader defending progressive taxation and opposing wealth tax cuts.

design_detail: Party alternative budget with third bracket in wealth tax over 100m NOK
quote_original: Partiet vil øke formuesskatten ved å innføre et tredje trinn for formuer over 100 millioner kroner. Det alene vil gi økt skatteinngang på 15 milliarder kroner.
quote_en: The party wants to increase the wealth tax by introducing a third bracket for wealth exceeding 100 million kroner. That alone will yield increased tax revenue of 15 billion kroner.
source_title: Rødt vil hente milliarder i økte skatter
grading_note: Party budget platform calling for higher wealth tax bracket on fortunes over 100m NOK.

design_detail: Defending wealth tax against abolition while supporting targeted adjustments
quote_original: Vi er opptatt av en rettferdig fordeling, og da er en økning av bunnfradraget i formuesskatten mer treffsikkert enn å fjerne skatten på aksjeformuer, sier Moflag.
quote_en: We are concerned with fair distribution, and then an increase in the basic deduction in the wealth tax is more targeted than removing the tax on share fortunes, says Moflag.
source_title: En halv million nordmenn kan slippe formuesskatt
grading_note: Finance committee chair statement defending wealth tax against elimination.

design_detail: Defending existing wealth tax against repeal as mandate of general election
quote_original: Formuesskatten vil bestå de neste fire årene, slik den har gjort de siste tjue årene, sier stortingsrepresentant Geir Pollestad
quote_en: The wealth tax will remain for the next four years, as it has done for the past twenty years, says Member of the Storting Geir Pollestad
source_title: Sp åpner for vern med justeringer: – Formuesskatten vil bestå
grading_note: Sp budget negotiator and minister rejecting repeal of wealth tax.

design_detail: Economist defense of wealth tax debunking corporate lobby report on effective tax burden
quote_original: I Menons eksempler brukes emisjonsverdien som om selskapene var børsnoterte. Dermed blåses formuesskattens betydning opp i en slik grad at den farger resultatene.
quote_en: In Menon's examples the issue value is used as if the companies were listed. Thus the significance of the wealth tax is inflated to such an extent that it colours the results.
source_title: Graverende feil i NHO sin skatterapport
grading_note: Economics professor op-ed debunking anti-wealth-tax business lobby models.

design_detail: Finance professor defense of wealth tax debunking corporate lobby calculations
quote_original: I Menons eksempler brukes emisjonsverdien som om selskapene var børsnoterte. Dermed blåses formuesskattens betydning opp i en slik grad at den farger resultatene.
quote_en: In Menon's examples the issue value is used as if the companies were listed. Thus the significance of the wealth tax is inflated to such an extent that it colours the results.
source_title: Graverende feil i NHO sin skatterapport
grading_note: Finance professor op-ed defending tax system analysis against business lobby bias.

design_detail: Campaign for redistributive capital taxation including annual wealth tax
quote_original: Om det blir snudd om på Norsk skattepolitikk, må det bli den fremtidige regjeringens mål å skattlegge kapital mer. Dette gjennom skatter som formuesskatt, arveskatt og selskapsskatt.
quote_en: If Norwegian tax policy is reversed, it must be the future government's goal to tax capital more. This through taxes such as wealth tax, inheritance tax and corporate tax.
source_title: Norge går i feil retning i fordelingspolitikken!
grading_note: Civil society organisation policy piece advocating wealth and capital taxation.

design_detail: Trade union leadership opposing proposals to cut wealth tax
quote_original: Dette er helt bakvendt. Vi er ikke tjent med et mindre omfordelende skattesystem, tvert imot må skattesystemet bli mer progressivt, sier hun.
quote_en: This is completely backwards. We are not served by a less redistributive tax system; on the contrary, the tax system must become more progressive, she says.
source_title: NTL reagerer på skatteforslag: – Helt bakvendt
grading_note: Civil service union statement defending wealth tax against reduction.

design_detail: Union president defending progressive wealth taxation against reduction proposals
quote_original: Dette er helt bakvendt. Vi er ikke tjent med et mindre omfordelende skattesystem, tvert imot må skattesystemet bli mer progressivt, sier hun.
quote_en: This is completely backwards. We are not served by a less redistributive tax system; on the contrary, the tax system must become more progressive, she says.
source_title: NTL reagerer på skatteforslag: – Helt bakvendt
grading_note: Union president statement rejecting wealth tax cuts.

design_detail: Defended the wealth tax against NHO proposals to cut or eliminate it
quote_original: det finnes ingen dokumentasjon eller teorier om at lavere formuesskatt skaper flere arbeidsplasser ... ulikhetene har vokst de siste 10 årene. de rike har blitt rikere
quote_en: There is no documentation or theory indicating that lower wealth tax creates more jobs... Inequalities have grown over the past 10 years. The rich have become richer.
source_title: LO og NHO skulle diskutere ulikhet - endte i en debatt om formuesskatt
grading_note: Public debate statement by LO President defending the wealth tax against corporate employer lobby cuts.

design_detail: Official submission by LO warning against cuts to the wealth tax
quote_original: formuesskatten er en av de viktigste omfordelingsmekanismene i samfunnet ... opphopning av store formuer på få personer kan gi dem politisk makt og svekke demokratiet
quote_en: The wealth tax is one of the most important redistribution mechanisms in society... Accumulation of large fortunes in few hands can grant them political power and undermine democracy.
source_title: LO verner formuesskatten: frykter mer makt til de rike
grading_note: Public policy statement and official submission by LO leadership defending wealth taxation.

design_detail: Resolution and statement by AUF leadership defending the wealth tax
quote_original: valget i 2025 var en folkeavstemning om frp og formuesskatten, eller en fortsatt ap-regjering. en bred majoritet av velgerne sa da at de er enige med ap, ikke frp ... våre velgere skal ikke betale prisen for å kutte i formuesskatten
quote_en: The 2025 election was a referendum on FrP and the wealth tax, or a continued Labour government... Our voters will not pay the price for cuts to the wealth tax.
source_title: Slakter skattekutt: - Ikke dette Ap gikk til valg på
grading_note: Public policy declaration from AUF leadership rejecting wealth tax cuts.

design_detail: Statement by AUF leader rejecting proposals to cut the wealth tax

quote_en: The 2025 election was a referendum on FrP and the wealth tax, or a continued Labour government... Our voters will not pay the price for cuts to the wealth tax.
source_title: Slakter skattekutt: - Ikke dette Ap gikk til valg på
grading_note: Interview and statement by AUF leader defending the wealth tax.

design_detail: Official political program advocating sharply increased progressive wealth tax on fortunes and millionaire tax
quote_original: ha et mer progressivt skattesystem som letter skatten for lønnsarbeidere med lav inntekt ... øker den kraftig for de med store formuer og høye inntekter ... innføringen av en millionærskatt
quote_en: Maintain a more progressive tax system lowering taxes on low-income workers, while sharply increasing taxes on large fortunes and high incomes... introduction of a millionaire tax.
source_title: SU Politikk: Skatt
grading_note: Official taxation platform adopted by Sosialistisk Ungdom.

design_detail: Official taxation program advocating increased wealth tax on large fortunes
quote_original: rød ungdom jobber for et samfunn med mer rettferdig fordeling ... jobbe for å øke formueskatten
quote_en: Rød Ungdom works for a society with fairer distribution... Working to increase the wealth tax.
source_title: Rød Ungdom Politikk: Skatt
grading_note: Official taxation manifesto adopted by Rød Ungdom.

design_detail: Official stance defending the 34 billion NOK revenue from the wealth tax
quote_original: staten tjener 34 milliarder kroner årlig fra formuesskatten ... jeg vil heller bruke pengene vi tjener fra formuesskatt på bedre velferd for oss alle
quote_en: The state collects 34 billion NOK annually from the wealth tax... I would rather use the revenues from the wealth tax on better welfare for all of us.
source_title: Grønn Ungdom reagerer på skatteforslag fra moderpartiet: - Uansvarlig
grading_note: Official statement from youth wing leadership defending the wealth tax.

design_detail: Statement by Grønn Ungdom deputy leader opposing wealth tax cuts
quote_original: staten tjener 34 milliarder kroner årlig fra formuesskatten ... jeg vil heller bruke pengene vi tjener fra formuesskatt på bedre velferd for oss alle
quote_en: The state collects 34 billion NOK annually from the wealth tax... I would rather use the revenues from the wealth tax on better welfare for all of us.
source_title: Grønn Ungdom reagerer på skatteforslag fra moderpartiet: - Uansvarlig
grading_note: Interview and statement by Grønn Ungdom deputy leader.

design_detail: Confederation submission and statement opposing cuts in wealth taxation for top earners
quote_original: den øverste 1-prosenten av skattebetalerne i norge omfattes ikke av vårt progressive skattesystem ... både formuesskatten og en eventuell ny arveavgift bør ha høye bunnfradrag
quote_en: The top 1% of taxpayers in Norway are not covered by our progressive tax system... Both the wealth tax and a potential inheritance tax should have high basic allowances.
source_title: Handal mener Skattekommisjonen ikke tar grep i samlet beskatning av formue
grading_note: Confederation policy statement defending wealth taxation.

design_detail: Presidential statement opposing wealth tax reductions favoring the top 1%
quote_original: den øverste 1-prosenten av skattebetalerne i norge omfattes ikke av vårt progressive skattesystem ... både formuesskatten og en eventuell ny arveavgift bør ha høye bunnfradrag
quote_en: The top 1% of taxpayers in Norway are not covered by our progressive tax system... Both the wealth tax and a potential inheritance tax should have high basic allowances.
source_title: Handal mener Skattekommisjonen ikke tar grep i samlet beskatning av formue
grading_note: Public statement by Unio President defending wealth taxation.

design_detail: Trade union response opposing cuts to the 20 billion NOK municipal and state wealth tax revenues
quote_original: for fo er den prinsipielle tilnærminga åpenbar. når forskjellene øker ... dersom formuesskatten reduseres, vil staten vil tape over 20 milliarder kroner i årlige inntekter
quote_en: For FO, the principled approach is obvious. When inequality rises... If the wealth tax is cut, the state will lose over 20 billion NOK in annual revenue.
source_title: - Øker risikoen for større forskjeller
grading_note: Trade union policy statement defending wealth tax funding for public services.

design_detail: Statement by FO President opposing wealth tax cuts
quote_original: for fo er den prinsipielle tilnærminga åpenbar. når forskjellene øker ... dersom formuesskatten reduseres, vil staten vil tape over 20 milliarder kroner i årlige inntekter
